entry.rootCause:
Betters and LeBull have both moved their sportsbook from the old sbteam "classic" platform to Betby (bettech) sometime between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-06. The endpoint the scrapers intercept, `/leagues/{id}/upcoming`, no longer exists on either brand, and the numeric league IDs (4485 and so on) mean nothing on the new platform. Changing constants alone will not fix this.

(1) BETTERS: the SSR host `https://betterspl-ssr.boxwebcdn.work` has been shut down. It returns an nginx `404 Not Found` (548 bytes, through Cloudflare) for every path, including `/` and `/pl/league/1/4485`. www.betters.pl `/share/bootstrap` now returns `bettech_brand_id` "2658970707769307140" and `bettech_script` "https://betters.sptpub.com/bt-renderer.min.js`. The SPA mounts Betby's BTRenderer on `/zaklady-sportowe`, and odds come from `https://api-h-c7818b61-608.sptpub.com/api/v4/prematch/brand/2658970707769307140/...`. `sb_host` in that bootstrap still names the dead SSR host, which is a stale value.

(2) LEBULL: www.lebull.pl `/share/bootstrap` now returns `sb_host` "https://lebull-pl-bb.boxwebcdn.work/". The old host `lebullpl-ssr.boxwebcdn.work` also returns nginx 404 everywhere. The new host is a client-side Betby SPA. Its `/assets/public/config.json` gives `betbyApiUrl` "https://betting-betby-secundus.prod.sbteam.xyz" and `betbyBrandId` "2694137186776920067". Odds come from `/v5/prematch/brand/{brand}/pl/{version}`. On the new host, `/pl/league/1/4485` renders "Nie znaleziono strony" (page not found) and never calls `/upcoming`.

How the failure stays silent: `page.goto()` does not throw on HTTP 404. `captureLeagueEvents` ignores the response status, so it never logs "Navigation failed". The listener sees no `/leagues/4485/upcoming` response and the 8s capture timer resolves `[]`. `scrapeFullOffer` then returns `success=false` with the generic error "No events found from API".

There are fixtures right now (Premier League has 11–12 matches today/tomorrow on both brands). This is not a geo or bot block: the new APIs answer plain curl requests with 200 and no cookies.
evidence: Live log (backend.clean.log lines 92-93, 220-221, 233-235; again at 36395-36518): 'Navigating to: https://betterspl-ssr.boxwebcdn.work/pl/league/1/4485 (extended markets)' -> 'Capture timeout after 8000ms' -> 'betters completed: success=false, 0 matches'; same for lebullpl-ssr. No 'Navigation failed' line, because goto does not throw on 404.

curl https://betterspl-ssr.boxwebcdn.work/pl/league/1/4485 and https://lebullpl-ssr.boxwebcdn.work/pl/league/1/4485 -> HTTP/2 404, server cloudflare, body '

404 Not Found

' (548 B). The SSR root '/' also returns 404, so the whole host is gone, not just one route.

Playwright load of https://www.betters.pl/pl/league/1/4485 -> SPA title '404 - STRONA NIE ISTNIEJE'. GET https://www.betters.pl/share/bootstrap -> {"sb_host":"https://betterspl-ssr.boxwebcdn.work/","bettech_brand_id":"2658970707769307140","bettech_script":"https://betters.sptpub.com/bt-renderer.min.js",...}. main.94bfad95.js contains `isBettechSB:Boolean(bettech_brand_id)`, `window.SB=new window.BTRenderer`, the route `sportsbook:"/zaklady-sportowe*"` and the constant `betby`.

Playwright load of https://www.betters.pl/zaklady-sportowe -> XHRs only to Betby: api-h-c7818b61-608.sptpub.com/api/v4/prematch/brand/2658970707769307140/pl/0 (manifest), .../pl/{version} (snapshot chunks, up to 4 MB), .../prematch/brand/2658970707769307140/event/pl/{eventId} (full event markets), /api/v3/descriptions/... No request to /leagues/*/upcoming.

Playwright load of https://lebull-pl-bb.boxwebcdn.work/pl/league/1/4485 -> body shows 'Nie znaleziono strony' (page not found). XHRs: betting-betby-secundus.prod.sbteam.xyz/v5/prematch/brand/2694137186776920067/pl/0 and /pl/{version}, /v4/descriptions/brand/.../markets/pl. No /upcoming request. The new route table in the vendors bundle is /league/:sportId/:countryId/:leagueId and /event/:sportId/:countryId/:leagueId/:eventId. https://lebull-pl-bb.boxwebcdn.work/league/1/1669818860410376192/1669818860469096448 renders the Premier League with odds (Leeds-Tottenham 2.76/3.35/2.56), which matches the API exactly.

Plain curl (no browser, no cookies) returns 200 on both APIs. LeBull manifest {version:1793980992100, top_events_versions:[...100], rest_events_versions:[...101..106]}: 7 chunks of 67-108 KB, 645 tournaments and 2719 events. Betters manifest plus 7 chunks are the same size and shape.

Betby tournament IDs, the same on both brands (Betby is global), are 19-digit strings. Verified match counts on Betters: ekstraklasa 1669818868635406336 (9), premier-league 1669818860469096448 (11; LeBull 12 incl. outright), laliga 1669819032615915520 (10), serie-a 1669819042829045760 (10), ligue-1 1669818844560101376 (9). International 'Mistrzostwa Świata' (World Cup) = 1670073988614852608. Category ids: england 1669818860410376192, poland 1669818868555714560, spain 1669817290067152896, italy 1669819042774519808, france 1669818844505575424.

Event 2725816334213586962 (Leeds-Tottenham) has the same id on both brands and 161 markets in each event endpoint. Odds differ by brand margin (1X2 LeBull 2.76/3.35/2.56 vs Betters 2.72/3.30/2.52; 4 of 2285 outcomes differ), so these are two separate offers to keep.

Betby response shape: events[id] = {desc:{scheduled:<unix s>, type:'match'|outright, slug, sport:'1', category, tournament, competitors:[{id,name,abbreviation}...]}, markets:{<marketId>:{<specifier e.g. 'total=2.5' or ''>:{<outcomeId>:{k:'1.93'}}}}, state}. Market ids are Sportradar UOF: 1=1x2 (1/2/3), 10=Podwójna szansa (9=1X,10=12,11=X2), 18=Suma (12=over,13=under), 29=Obie drużyny strzelą gola (74 tak, 76 nie), 16=Handicap (hcp=..., 1714/1715). Listing chunks carry only markets 1/10/16/18; full markets require the event endpoint. Some team names carry trailing spaces ('Tottenham Hotspur ', 'Manchester City ').

git: betters/lebull scraper dirs last touched b606e25 (2026-08-20, odds filter only). Navigation/constants unchanged since 570ab66 (2026-06-17). The code still targets *-ssr.boxwebcdn.work and /leagues/{id}/upcoming.

Visibility: GET http://localhost:3001/api/health -> premier-league {successCount:9, errorCount:5}, an aggregate count with no bookmaker names. Per-bookmaker status exists only in the in-memory scraperHealth (GET /api/admin/scrapers/health, needs auth), with lastError 'No events found from API'. `insertScraperRuns` is imported at src/services/scraper-service.ts:3 but never called, so the scraper_runs table is not written. `getFailingScrapers()` is used only by that admin route. There is no webhook or alert.
entry.proposedFix:
No constants-only fix exists. Replace the sbteam-classic capture with a shared Betby HTTP client used by both brands. A plain fetch is enough, no Playwright.

1) NEW shared module, e.g. src/scrapers/shared/betby/{client.ts,parser.ts,types.ts}. Per-brand config:
   - betters: apiBase="https://api-h-c7818b61-608.sptpub.com/api/v4", brandId="2658970707769307140", eventUrl=`https://www.betters.pl/zaklady-sportowe/soccer/${categorySlug}/${tournamentSlug}/${eventSlug}-${eventId}` (link format checked against live anchors on betters.pl).
   - lebull: apiBase="https://betting-betby-secundus.prod.sbteam.xyz/v5" (descriptions at .../v4/descriptions/brand/{brand}/markets/pl), brandId="2694137186776920067", eventUrl=`https://lebull-pl-bb.boxwebcdn.work/event/1/${categoryId}/${tournamentId}/${eventId}` (league route /league/1/{categoryId}/{tournamentId} checked live).
   Flow:
   (a) GET {apiBase}/prematch/brand/{brand}/pl/0 → manifest.
   (b) GET {apiBase}/prematch/brand/{brand}/pl/{v} for each v in [...top_events_versions, ...rest_events_versions], merging `events`, `tournaments` and `categories`.
   (c) Keep events where desc.tournament === tournamentId && desc.type === 'match'.
   (d) For the full offer, GET {apiBase}/prematch/brand/{brand}/event/pl/{eventId} with a small delay between calls; this returns about 160 markets.

2) League IDs → Betby tournament IDs as STRINGS. They are 19 digits, above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, so they must never be parsed to number. Event ids are strings for the same reason. Values: ekstraklasa "1669818868635406336", premier-league "1669818860469096448", laliga "1669819032615915520", serie-a "1669819042829045760", ligue-1 "1669818844560101376", world-cup "1670073988614852608". Places to change:
   - betters/constants.ts:20-27
   - lebull/constants.ts:23-30, plus LEAGUE_URLS at 35-42
   - config/leagues.ts:35-36, 57-58, 79-80, 101-102, 123-124, 144-145
   - `Record<string, number>` → `Record<string, string>`; getLeagueId/getAllLeagueIds (betters/navigation.ts:175,214; lebull/navigation.ts:184,224) return string; BettersEvent.eventId (betters/types.ts:41) and the LebullEvent equivalent become string.
   - Remove BASE_URL (betters/constants.ts:14, lebull/constants.ts:12), buildLeagueUrl/buildEventUrl (betters/constants.ts:169-178, lebull/constants.ts:155) and setupRouteInterception (betters/navigation.ts:58-74, lebull/navigation.ts:68-86).
   - Replace captureLeagueEvents (betters/navigation.ts:88-170, lebull/navigation.ts:98-176) and lebull fetchEventDetails (navigation.ts:238+) with the Betby client.

3) Rewrite betters/parser.ts and lebull/parser.ts, ideally as one shared Betby parser, for the shape events[id].desc.{scheduled (unix seconds → ISO startTime), competitors[0|1].name.trim(), slug, category, tournament} plus markets[marketId][specifier][outcomeId].k (string odds). Map UOF ids for the core markets: 1→1X2 (1/2/3), 10→DC (9=1X, 10=12, 11=X2), 18→O/U (specifier total=X; 12 over, 13 under), 29→BTTS (74/76), 16→handicap (hcp=X; 1714/1715). Take market and outcome names from the descriptions endpoint (85 KB gz, cacheable).

4) Normalizers: src/services/normalization/bookmakers/betters-normalizer.ts, lebull-normalizer.ts and the betters/lebull entries in src/data/market-catalog.ts are keyed on sbteam stake-type ids (274556, 332819, 332813, ...). Those ids no longer exist. Write one Betby/UOF-keyed normalizer and share it between both brands. Update the parser tests in betters/__tests__ and lebull/__tests__ with Betby fixtures (samples saved under the scratchpad scraper-diag/{betters,lebull}/).

5) Hardening, so this kind of change is reported instead of silent:
   - Check `response.status()` and the host on every fetch/goto, and put e.g. "HTTP 404 from betterspl-ssr.boxwebcdn.work" into result.error instead of "No events found from API" (betters/index.ts:264, lebull/index.ts:79,246).
   - Actually call insertScraperRuns in services/scraper-service.ts so per-bookmaker failures are persisted.

Interim: until this is rewritten, remove betters/lebull from CONFIG.BOOKMAKERS (config/index.ts:17-18,62-63) so each run stops spending 8s+ and two browsers on them. Also make sure the frontend does not show odds left over from August.
entry.notes:
Read-only diagnosis. Nothing in aityper-scraper-api was edited and nothing was restarted. Live traffic was about 8 Playwright page loads and about 20 small JSON requests in total. Scratch files and response samples are under /tmp/claude-1000/-home-skamik-Documents-repositories-personal-aityper/3627e2c8-f787-4f71-8a6a-348993c930fc/scratchpad/scraper-diag/betters/ (pub_sb.json network log, manifest.json, v_*.json snapshot chunks, event_v4.json, probe.cjs) and .../scraper-diag/lebull/ (bb_league*.json, manifest.json, v_*.json, event_v5.json, descriptions.json, links.cjs).

Both brands now run on the same Betby platform with the same global tournament and event IDs. A single shared Betby scraper parameterized by {apiBase, brandId, eventUrl builder} covers both, and probably any other Betby-based Polish brand later. LeBull reaches Betby through an sbteam proxy (betting-betby-secundus.prod.sbteam.xyz, API v5); Betters calls Betby directly (api-h-c7818b61-608.sptpub.com, API v4). Response shapes are identical.

The Betby `api-h-<hash>-<n>.sptpub.com` hostname may rotate. A robust client should read it at runtime: for Betters from the BTRenderer bootstrap; for LeBull from https://lebull-pl-bb.boxwebcdn.work/assets/public/config.json (`betbyApiUrl`). Hard-coding it is the alternative. There is also a WebSocket (wss://api1-ws.sptpub.com/api/v1) for live deltas, but prematch polling over REST is enough.

The parsers, normalizers and catalog entries for both brands are all tied to the old sbteam stake-type ids, so this is a rewrite of scraper, parser and normalizer (effort L), not a URL swap. The many market-audit fixes in betters/lebull normalizers will not carry over.

Not related to this task but seen in the same log: totalbet logs 'API error: HTTP 404' and also returns 0 matches. That is a separate failure and probably the fifth of the 5 errors /api/health reports.
